desc: 杉墨深场与苔石台面的管装草本点涂膏套图，功效栏位一律留空
name: 苔石冷雾草本点涂膏款

shots.intent: 承担搜索列表的一眼点击：把软管以图鉴纸案上的直立静物形式干净呈现，全形无遮挡、无任何字标干扰。
一秒给出唯一主张：苔石台面上的冷雾静物配一行标题与一行短标，全部文字交给占位符。
shots.textZone: upper right third, one headline plus one short callout line

shots.intent: 放大真实生活里的社交困扰，但只用去身份的局部画面承载，绝不出现任何患部或皮肤细节。
shots.textZone: left headroom for one headline plus one line on the leaf tag

shots.intent: 让买家代入晨间护理流程，只用一只手完成取膏与点涂手势，产品仍是画面主体。
用两栏同机位实拍交代管口与卷边等可见结构差别，比较只停留在工艺层面，不给任何结果结论。
shots.textZone: top band of each panel, two short labels

shots.intent: 以可实拍的膏体旋纹与表面光泽证明质地本身，微距只对着料体，不对着任何皮肤。
用 90 度侧面微距交代管口、管肩与尾部卷压工艺，把结构讲清楚以替代任何功效说法。
用图鉴式平铺与一整列空白参数行回应规格疑问，所有数值与资质栏位一律留空。
shots.textZone: right column of blank spec rows plus one small label

shots.intent: 给出单支与组合的选购关系，只用可见件数与包装形制说话，不写任何价格与数量数字。
以完全可实拍的铝管卷边、旋盖螺纹与封口结构收口去风险，不用任何资质或检测背书。
shots.textZone: lower band carrying one short closing line

style.backgroundSystem: only two fields alternate across the set: a herbarium paper white #ECF2E9 sheet carrying a faint hairline graph ruling for packshot and spec screens, and a deep fir-ink green #123229 misted botanical field for story screens; a moss-flocked stone ledge in pale lichen #D8E2D2 is the single shared prop plane joining them
style.iconSystem: single-weight thin-line glyphs in #69B7B0 held inside hexagon die-cut frames; no filled badges, no medals, no seals, no medical or protective marks
style.lightingSystem: cool 6000K diffused light always entering from the upper left, soft wrapped shadows, fine dew mist hanging in the beam, one thin controlled rim travelling along the tube shoulder, never hard speculars and never a warm cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent herbarium apothecary still-life system across the entire image set; fixed palette of herbarium paper white #ECF2E9, deep fir-ink green #123229, fresh moss-stem green #5E9B52 and one cold dew teal accent #69B7B0, laid over a fine-grained moss-stone ledge #D8E2D2; cool 6000K diffused light entering from the upper left with soft wrapped shadows, fine dew mist and one thin rim on the tube shoulder; modern geometric sans-serif set in #123229 on paper white with one thin #69B7B0 rule under each headline; single-weight thin-line hexagon icons only; hexagon die-cut cards, taped paper cards, leaf-shaped tags and one hairline circle inset window are the only graphic devices; stable upright packshot scale, crimped tail and level cap line; no colour palette changes, no anatomical or skin diagrams, no magnified blemish imagery, no crosses or shields, no certificates or numeric proof marks, no splash, foam, pearl or mirror motifs, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no colour palette changes outside #ECF2E9, #123229, #5E9B52, #69B7B0 and #D8E2D2
no medical or anatomical graphics of any kind: no skin cross-sections, no follicle or pore diagrams, no molecule formulas, no magnified blemish photography, no germ characters
no protective or authority marks: no crosses, no shields, no certificates, no seals, no inspection or laboratory wording, no registration numbers
no numeric proof marks: no percentages, no rising arrows, no progress rings, no timeline numerals, no test figures
no water splash, ripple, pearl, cloud-foam or mirror-reflection motifs
no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting between screens
style.presentationRules: the tube is always the same object at the same scale: crimped tail up or laid flat, standing on its own cap, cap line level across every screen; two-unit and three-unit arrangements keep identical spacing and identical light
style.surfaceSystem: fine-grained moss-flocked stone ledge and pale lichen stone slab #D8E2D2, matte and lightly porous with visible mineral grain; never marble, never mirror plate, never polished acrylic
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif set in deep fir-ink #123229 on the paper white field, one thin cold dew teal #69B7B0 rule under each headline, short labels only and all rendered copy supplied as placeholders
